symptom: `mxcli syntax message-definition` documented only `CREATE … MESSAGE DEFINITION COLLECTION`, which an 11.15+ project refuses, and its Requires block said `Mendix 10.0.0+` for the collection; the 11.15 document form appeared only in an exec hint, and a user wrote its folder clause after FOR (`… for Shop.ApiTicket folder 'Api' { … }` -> "mismatched input 'folder' expecting {AS, '(', '{'}") and concluded it had none
cause: The syntax entry was written for the collection and never updated when #987 added the document form. Separately, sdk/versions dedup() merged mendix-10.yaml's and mendix-11.yaml's message_definition_collection entries (same 10.0.0 floor) keeping the FIRST — the one without max_version: 11.14.99 — so IsAvailable said the collection exists on 11.16 and the syntax page could not show the ceiling
file: `cmd/mxcli/syntax/features_integration.go` (document form first, collection marked 11.14-and-earlier); `cmd/mxcli/syntax/format.go`/`versions.go` (Requirement.Until rendered as `10.0.0 to 11.14.99`); `sdk/versions/registry.go` dedup prefers the entry that states a max_version
insight: The FOLDER clause existed all along (name, FOLDER, then FOR — the order of every document statement, and what describe prints); before adding a second clause position for a 'missing' clause, try it where describe puts it. A max_version in one per-major YAML is silently lost when another file lists the same floor without one: any ceiling added to a feature that an older file also lists needs a registry test, as TestMessageDefinitionCollectionEndsAt1114 now is.
